ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_001_cost_norm_shifted_sum_advgap_v2_repaired
ir.intuition: Replace unsupported ops.sign with safe sign approximation using clamp and relu to fix runtime error while preserving original loss logic.
ir.pseudocode:
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
norm = abs(log_prob_w) + abs(log_prob_l) + epsilon
scaled_diff = diff / norm
cost_diff = cost_b - cost_a
cost_gap_sign = sign(cost_diff) approximated as relu(clamp(cost_diff, -1,1)) - relu(clamp(-cost_diff, -1,1))
quality_signal = -0.1 * cost_gap_sign + 0.2 * advantage_gap
x = alpha * scale * scaled_diff + quality_signal
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
loss = loss * weight
loss_mean = sum(loss) / sum(weight)

ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))
    cost_a = batch['cost_a']
    cost_b = batch['cost_b']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    diff = lpw - lpl
    norm = ops.abs(lpw) + ops.abs(lpl) + epsilon
    scaled_diff = diff / norm
    cost_diff = cost_b - cost_a
    # Approximate sign using relu and clamp
    pos = ops.relu(ops.clamp(cost_diff, -1.0, 1.0))
    neg = ops.relu(ops.clamp(-cost_diff, -1.0, 1.0))
    cost_gap_sign = pos - neg
    quality_signal = -0.1 * cost_gap_sign + 0.2 * advantage_gap
    x = alpha * scale * scaled_diff + quality_signal
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)
    loss = loss * weight
    return ops.sum(loss) / ops.sum(weight)
